title: Temperature Table
hints: In main, loop from start to end, adding step each time, and call toFahrenheit for every value.
Print each row with "%d C = %.1f F".formatted(c, toFahrenheit(c)).

pt-br.title: Tabela de temperaturas
hints: No main, faça um laço de start até end, somando step a cada volta, e chame toFahrenheit para cada valor.
Imprima cada linha com "%d C = %.1f F".formatted(c, toFahrenheit(c)).
mustContain: Mantenha a assinatura do método: double toFahrenheit(double celsius).
Use um laço para imprimir as linhas.

mustContain.message: Keep the method signature: double toFahrenheit(double celsius).
Use a loop to print the rows.
